Iran denies IAEA access to bombed nuclear sites, limits other access

Iran's Parliament Speaker Ali Ghalibaf has stated that reports of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) being granted access to bombed sites are false. However, access to the Bushehr and Tehran reactor sites has reportedly been limited. This development comes amid ongoing international scrutiny of Iran's nuclear program.
